notes.title: Java Saga RPG Direct Demo!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44084443/866b613217b398cf0eba3e6739585678ca145c48.png"][/img]The Java Saga RPG Direct Demo is finally here![/p][p]Fashionably late by one month, the Java Saga RPG Direct Demo is now available! Beat the heat with a boiling hot treat from Black Cat Coffee and team Neptune 64, on the house![/p][p][/p][p]This build's big focus was adding cutscenes and a tutorial battle to the structure, and the team at Neptune 64 hope you find these new additions to be pretty cool. You can collect Wax Tangerines if you want a nice sense of accomplishment too, I guess.[/p][p][/p][p]This demo is intended to be played with an Xbox One controller, but keyboard controls are an option too!
Just check out the Options Menu for the controls. :3[/p]

notes.title: Incoming Demo!
notes.notes:
[p]Black Cat Coffee is happy to present a fresh new demo for Java Saga!
...But not just yet. We need a few more days to add some final fixes, but we're still gonna make it in time for the RPG Direct event! Keep an eye out, and thanks for your patience.[/p]
